blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 社交媒体能够进行跨语言的交流,然而用户生成的内容(UGC)的含义往往在文本、图像和文化知识之间传播,使翻译工作具有挑战性。 现有的评价通常将图像视为可选的,并假定文字信息足够充分,从而模糊了错误是否出自缺少视觉证据或文化适应不足。 我们在社交媒体翻译中引入\textbf{Culture-MMT}\textbf{分发证据的实用重建}的诊断基准。 它包含498个经整理、解析的UGC案例,涉及20个领域,按所需证据分为符号、视觉和混合。 我们还发展了与人相通的具体领域法官Judger,以及系统改变翻译可用证据的控制评价框架。 在整个17个模型配置中,真实的图像在Visual上能通过+0.280来提高性能,在Hybrid上能通过+0.197来提高性能,但在符号上只能通过+0.050来提高性能,而随机的图像则不能提供可比较的收益. 人类授权的描述进一步表明,即使视觉事实明确,共同依赖的案件仍然更具挑战性。 这些成果将文化上有效的社会-媒体翻译定性为{指从已分发的证据中重建},强调视觉地基和文化适应是独特的示范瓶颈。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Social media has facilitated cross-lingual communication, with user-generated content (UGC) being both dynamic and challenging to translate. ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) Unlike news or documents, the meaning of a UGC post rarely resides in text alone: authors often omit visually evident objects, scenes, attributes, and in-image text, while using internet memes and community-specific slang to convey attitudes. ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) Thus, the evidence required for culturally effective translation may be distributed across text, visual context, and shared cultural knowledge. For text-only systems, the challenge is not merely language understanding and generation, but the intrinsic absence of critical task-relevant information from the source text ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Caglayan et al., 2019 ; Fantinuoli, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 社交媒体促进了跨语言的交流,用户生成的内容(UGC)既充满活力又具有翻译挑战性. (吴等,2026;邱等,2026). 与新闻或文档不同, UGC 帖子的意义很少仅存在于文本中:作者经常忽略视觉可见的物体,场景,属性,以及内图文本,同时使用互联网元音和特定社区的语气来表达态度. (袁等,2026年;潘等,2026年;赵等,2026年) 因此,在文化上有效的翻译所需的证据可以跨文字,视觉背景,分享文化知识. 对于只使用文本的系统,挑战不仅仅是语言理解和生成,而是源文本中缺乏关键任务相关信息的内在缺失(Gao等人,2025年;Caglayan等人,2019年;Fantinuoli,2025年)。

blocks.en: This distributed-evidence problem remains underexplored in culturally aware translation and multimodal machine translation ( Villa-Cueva et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . CULTURE-MT ( Wu et al., 2026 ) evaluates cultural effectiveness in UGC translation but focuses on content that can be judged from text alone. Classical multimodal translation often uses image descriptions as source text, where visual and textual information are redundant ( Chai et al., 2026 ; Dash et al., 2026 ) ; even ambiguity-oriented tasks typically focus on selecting the correct linguistic interpretation ( Villa-Cueva et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Real-world UGC is different: images may contain entities omitted from the text, while shared cultural knowledge determines how these facts should be expressed in the target language ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . As shown in Figure 1 , the key question is not simply “whether images help,” but whether models can access the evidence required for translation and integrate it across modalities into a culturally effective target-language expression .
blocks.zh: 这一分布式证据问题在文化意识的翻译和多式机器翻译方面仍然没有得到充分的探讨(Villa-Cueva等人,2025年;Pan等人,2026年)。 CulLTURE-MT(Wu et al., 2026)评价UGC翻译中的文化有效性,但侧重于仅从文本中判断的内容. 古典多式翻译经常使用图像描述作为源文本,其中视觉和文字信息是冗余的(Chai等人,2026年;Dash等人,2026年);甚至模糊导向的任务通常都侧重于选择正确的语言解释(Villa-Cueva等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年). Real-world UGC不同:图像可能包含文本中省略的实体,而共享文化知识则决定这些事实应如何用目标语言表达(Guo等人,2026年). 如图1所示,关键问题不仅仅是“图像是否有用”,而是模型是否能够获取翻译所需的证据,并将其纳入各种模式,从而形成文化上有效的目标语言表达方式。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce Culture-MMT, the first benchmark for culturally pragmatic multimodal translation from Chinese social media to English. It contains 498 de-identified real-world UGC posts across 20 domains, divided into three balanced subsets ( Wu et al., 2026 ) of 166 instances based on required evidence: Symbol (internet cultural knowledge, without image dependence), Visual (key facts conveyed by images, without cultural memes), and Hybrid (requiring visual fact recognition and cultural knowledge). This design isolates visual evidence completion, cultural-pragmatic mapping, and their interaction.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了文化-MMT,这是将文化实用的多式联运从中国社交媒体翻译成英文的第一个基准。 它包含498个已解析的20个领域的现实世界UGC帖子,根据所需证据分为3个均衡子集(Wu等人,2026年)166个案例:符号(网络间文化知识,没有图像依赖性),视觉(图像传递的关键事实,没有文化元件),混合(需要视觉事实识别和文化知识). 这种设计隔离了视觉证据的完成,文化-prographic映射,以及它们的相互作用.

blocks.en: We further train a human-aligned domain-specific judge ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Belmadani et al., 2026 ; Fu and Liu, 2025 ) , Judger, and establish a controlled evaluation protocol in which the judge uses the same human-verified image description, while the translator receives one of four evidence conditions: no visual evidence, the real image, a random image, or a human-authored description. Across 17 model configurations, real images yield gains of +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions alleviate part of the perceptual gap, yet Hybrid remains harder than Visual even when visual facts are explicit, showing that visual fact access does not imply successful cultural adaptation. Overall, Culture-MMT evaluates not only translation quality but also whether failures arise from evidence access, visual fact recovery, or cultural adaptation, revealing these as related but non-interchangeable capability stages.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步培养了与人相通的域别法官(Wu等人,2026年;Belmadani等人,2026年;Fu and Liu,2025年;Judger),并建立了控制评价协议,在协议中,法官使用相同的人验证图像描述,而翻译者接收了四个证据条件之一:没有视觉证据,真实图像,随机图像,或者人授权的描述. 在17个模型配置中,真实图像在Visual上得到+0.280的收获,在Hybrid上得到+0.197的收获,但在符号上只得到+0.050的收获,而随机图像则不能提供可比的收获. 人类授权的描述缓解了部分认知差距,然而,即使视觉事实明确,混合体仍然比视觉更难,这表明视觉事实的获取并不意味着成功的文化适应. 总的来说,文化-MMT不仅评价翻译质量,而且评价失败是否来自证据获取、视觉事实恢复或文化适应,揭示这些是相关但不可互换的能力阶段。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce Culture-MMT and establish a distributed-evidence perspective for social-media translation, with 498 real-world, de-identified UGC posts categorized by three evidence-dependence types. • We develop a diagnostic evaluation framework for visually grounded cultural effectiveness, featuring a human-aligned Judger and a controlled protocol that fixes evaluation evidence while varying translator-side evidence. • We evaluate 17 model configurations under four evidence conditions, showing that visual gains are evidence-specific and that visual fact recovery and cultural adaptation are related but non-interchangeable capabilities.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引进了文化-MMT,并为社会-媒体翻译确定了分布式证据视角,有498个真实世界、被解析的UGC职位被分类为三种证据依赖类型。 • 我们为视觉文化效果制定一个诊断性评价框架,其特点是一个与人相适应的法官和一个控制协议,既确定评价证据,又确定不同的翻译方证据。 我们评价了在四个证据条件下的17个模型配置,显示视觉收益是具体的证据,视觉事实恢复和文化适应是相关但不可互换的能力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据构建

blocks.en: The data-construction pipeline is shown in Figure 2 and comprises candidate collection, human filtering, two-stage differential verification, privacy-preserving rewriting, and final quality control ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Candidates are collected from real Chinese social-media UGC across 20 20 verticals in non-overlapping crawling rounds (about 1,000 1{,}000 notes per round); for video notes, only static frames are retained. After normalization and corrupted-sample removal, a Gemini multimodal model ( Team et al., 2023 ) generates text-only and multimodal draft translations and temporary type labels for human filtering ( Shao et al., 2024a ) . Three AI-background graduate students conducted filtering and privacy-preserving rewriting over two weeks, judging each note for a valid cultural or visual translation point and overriding model labels when needed. Visual and Hybrid require key meanings unrecoverable from text alone, while Symbol requires a cultural translation challenge without necessary visual evidence. Details are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 数据构建管道如图2所示,包括候选人收集、人过滤、两阶段差分核查、隐私保存重写和最终质量控制(郑等人,2023年)。 从真实的中国社交媒体UGC中收集候选人,在非重叠爬行轮20个纵横(每轮约1000 1{,}000个笔记);对于视频笔记,只保留静态帧. 双子座多式联运模式(Team et al., 2023)在正常化和腐败的采样清除后,生成仅限文本和多式联运的翻译草稿和人类过滤的临时类型标签(Shao et al., 2024a ). 三名AI背景研究生在两周内进行了过滤和隐私保护重写,根据有效的文化或视觉翻译点判断每张笔记,必要时还标有压倒性的模型标签。 视觉和混合需要关键含义,仅从文本中无法恢复,而符号则需要文化翻译挑战,而没有必要的视觉证据. 详情见附录F。

blocks.en: Human judgment alone can still let “pseudo-hard” cases slip in—cases that strong models can translate correctly without the image ( Ma et al., 2025 ) . In a review of 159 159 passed samples with Gemini, about one third were correctly translatable without the image, with 20 20 – 30 % 30\% noise in the previous difficulty labels. We therefore introduce a two-stage automatic filter. The first is a feature-based coarse filter without LLM calls: it keeps samples of 5 5 – 30 30 characters containing Chinese characters and a visual or strong textual signal (e.g., code-switching, elided references, named entities), while removing catch-all phrases, generic templates, and the Easy tier. The second is a model-based fine filter: Gemini generates an image description, a text-only translation, and a multimodal translation; our text Judger then scores the two translations under the same visual context, yielding gap = score ⁡ ( y m ​ m ∣ c ) − score ⁡ ( y t ​ x ​ t ∣ c ) , \mathrm{gap}=\mathrm{score}(y_{mm}\mid c)-\mathrm{score}(y_{txt}\mid c), (1) where c c is the image description. We keep samples with gap ≥ 1 \mathrm{gap}\geq 1 and rank them by gap. This directly measures the image’s contribution to translation quality, avoiding the false positives and negatives of word-overlap heuristics. Across all collection rounds, about 18,000 18{,}000 raw candidates were processed, with 6,972 6{,}972 surviving the coarse filter and 1,045 1{,}045 the differential filter ( gap ≥ 1 \mathrm{gap}\geq 1 ). Together with human-confirmed Symbol controls, these candidates underwent human re-review and privacy-preserving rewriting, yielding 498 498 final notes, with 166 166 per dependency type.

blocks.en: All candidates originate from real UGC ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . To protect privacy, we rewrite traceable surface details while preserving the original scenario, language phenomena, evidence-dependency type, and core translation point. Specifically, we preserve the vertical, register, narrative function, and the image’s role in understanding the text, while replacing identifiable people, nicknames, numbers, brands, and visual details. Titles, bodies, and images are jointly rewritten into coherent social-media notes to maintain their natural contextual flow. Images are regenerated using one of four role-specific strategies and pass perceptual-hash and structural-similarity checks; the full protocol is given in Appendix E . Thus, Culture-MMT is grounded in real UGC while releasing privacy-preserved instances that retain the original translation challenges.
blocks.zh: 所有候选人来自真正的UGC(廖等人,2025年). 为了保护隐私,我们重写可追踪的表面细节,同时保留原始情景,语言现象,证据依赖类型,以及核心翻译点. 具体地说,我们保留了垂直、注册、叙事功能,以及图像在理解文本方面的作用,同时取代可识别的人、昵称、数字、品牌和视觉细节。 标题、身体和图像被联合改写成连贯的社会媒体说明,以保持其自然背景流动。 图像使用四个特定角色策略之一进行再生成,并通过感知-hash和结构-同质性检查;完整的协议载于附录E。 因此,文化-MMT基于真正的UGC,同时释放保留原始翻译挑战的隐私保留实例。

blocks.en: 2.3 Data Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.3 国家 数据分析

blocks.en: This section summarizes the statistics of the released Culture-MMT set (Figure 3 ). The sealed set contains 498 498 real-sourced, de-identified notes with 518 518 regenerated images, selected from 1,329 1{,}329 original images by manually identifying the key image, yielding a note-to-image ratio of about 1 : 1.04 1{:}1.04 . The three evidence-dependency types are strictly balanced at 166 166 each, enabling controlled cross-type comparison. Of the 498 498 notes, 461 461 are image-text notes and 37 37 use video cover frames; 75 75 are title-only notes without a body. Source texts have a median length of 55 55 characters, a mean of 66.9 66.9 , and a p90 of 117 117 . blocks.en: 3 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3 评价框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Translator Evidence Conditions and the Cultural-Effectiveness Metric
blocks.zh: 3.1 翻译证据条件和文化有效性计量

blocks.en: Four translator input conditions form an intervention on evidence accessibility: Text Only provides only the text; Multimodal provides the native image matching the sample; Random Image provides an image drawn from another sample, used to distinguish relevant evidence from a generic multimodal input effect; and Human Caption provides a human-verified image description as evidence that does not participate in translation, used to relieve the visual-perception burden ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) . Each condition keeps the translation instruction unchanged; the full prompts are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 4个翻译输入条件构成对证据获取的干预: 文字 只提供文本; 多式联运提供与样本匹配的本土图像; 随机图像提供从另一个样本中抽取的图像,用于区分相关证据和通用多式联运输入效应; 人称描述作为不参与翻译的证据提供经人验证的图像描述,用于减轻视觉感知负担(邱等人,2026年). 每个条件都使翻译指令保持不变;完整提示载于附录D。

blocks.en: Cultural effectiveness is judged by the domain-specialized Chinese Judger trained in this work ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , loaded on self-hosted vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with 8 8 -way tensor parallelism ( tp = 8 \mathrm{tp}=8 ), using a fixed deterministic decoding configuration on the judge side to ensure reproducible and consistent scoring. Following the rubric of the CULTURE-MT ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , we report two metrics: the mean score is the average of the 0 0 – 3 3 scale, and the cultural-effectiveness rate is the proportion of samples scoring 2 2 or above ( 2 2 – 3 3 , i.e., semantically and pragmatically adequate), with 0 0 – 1 1 counted as ineffective; the visual gain Δ \Delta is the difference of the multimodal condition over the text-only condition on these metrics.

blocks.en: 3.2 The Controlled Evidence Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 受控证据议定书

blocks.en: The core of the protocol is to separate “what evidence the sample contains” from “what evidence the translator can access.” The Judger always reads the same human-verified image description for all translator conditions ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , because that description characterizes the sample’s ground truth rather than any single translator’s input; the evidence intervention occurs only on the translator side. We do not provide the judge with an enumerated “ambiguous word → \to correct meaning” answer ledger, to avoid degrading scoring into answer matching. With the judge’s information fixed, score changes across conditions can be interpreted as differences in the translator’s acquisition and use of evidence, providing a common reference for the subsequent failure attribution.

Moreover, we delegate “understanding the image” to human annotation and provide the judge with only the textual description: the benefit is that the judge’s visual ability no longer forms a ceiling on the evaluation ( Guo et al., 2025b ) , at the cost of the granularity of the human description becoming a new ceiling. The validity of Judger on our benchmark, including its agreement with human annotations and comparison with existing LLM judges, is evaluated in 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 此外,我们把 " 理解形象 " 交给人类注释,只向法官提供文字描述:好处是法官的视觉能力不再构成评价的上限(Guo等人,2025年b),而人类描述的颗粒性成为一个新的上限。 根据我们的基准,包括同意人的说明和与现有法学硕士法官的比较,法官的有效性在3.3中得到评价。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on 498 samples in Culture-MMT. The main results compare two translator input conditions, Text Only and Multimodal, while the judge uses only human caption; each model configuration is evaluated under both text-only and image-text conditions, with the judge always receiving the same human-verified visual evidence. We evaluate 17 model configurations in total, including the proprietary models GPT-5.5/5.6-sol ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Team et al., 2026b ) , Gemini-3.1-pro (high/low) ( Team et al., 2023 ) , and Qwen3.7-Flash ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , as well as the open-source models GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-397B-A17B ( Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-122B-A10B ( Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-27B/9B/4B ( Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-235B/32B/8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Gemma-4-31B ( Team et al., 2026a ) . Access details and inference parameters are given in Appendix G .

blocks.en: The visual benefit is evidence-selective, not a generic multimodal dividend. Figure 4 and Table 5 show that across 17 configurations, the average gains on Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid are + 0.050 +0.050 , + 0.280 +0.280 , and + 0.197 +0.197 , respectively. While Visual and Hybrid show positive gains for every configuration, Symbol remains small and unstable, with 5 configurations showing no gain or a drop. Images thus help consistently only when they provide information missing from the text; when translation relies mainly on shared cultural knowledge, they are often unhelpful and may distract. The lower gain on Hybrid further confirms this: jointly dependent samples retain symbolic difficulty that images cannot resolve, which persists in 4.3.2 even with human descriptions.
blocks.zh: 视觉好处是证据选择,而不是一种通用的多式联运红利。 图4和表5显示,在17个配置中,符号、视觉和混合的平均收益分别为+0.050+0.050、+0.280+0.280和+0.197+0.197。 虽然Visual和Hybrid显示每个配置都有正面收益,但符号仍然很小且不稳定,5个配置显示没有收益或下降. 因此,只有当图像提供了文本中缺失的信息时,图像才会持续发挥作用;当翻译主要依靠共享的文化知识时,图像往往无益,可能会分散注意力。 Hybrid的较低收益进一步证实了这一点:共同依赖的样本保留了图像无法解决的象征性困难,即使在人类的描述下,这种困难在4.3.2中仍然存在.

blocks.en: Visual access alleviates the information bottleneck but does not close the capability gap. Text-only and multimodal scores are highly consistent across models (Pearson r = 0.989 r=0.989 , computed from Table 5 ), with strong models remaining ahead after receiving images. Images mainly restore missing sample-level facts, while final quality remains constrained by language generation, pragmatic inference, and cultural transfer. Visual evidence thus alleviate input-side information constraints but cannot guarantee quality translation.
blocks.zh: 视觉访问可以缓解信息瓶颈,但不能弥合能力差距. 单文本和多模式的分数在各模型之间高度一致(Pearson r = 0.989 r = 0.989,从表5计算),强势模型在收到图像后仍然领先. 图像主要恢复了缺失的样本层面的事实,而最终质量仍然受到语言生成,实用推论和文化转移的制约. 因此,视觉证据减轻了输入方信息的限制,但不能保证高质量的翻译。

blocks.en: Scaling raises absolute quality, but evidence use does not scale monotonically. For the Qwen3.5 dense series (4B/9B/27B), the multimodal mean rises from 1.623 1.623 to 1.785 1.785 to 2.171 2.171 , while gains are + 0.229 / + 0.225 / + 0.267 +0.229/+0.225/+0.267 ; for Qwen3-VL (8B/32B/235B), the mean rises from 1.564 1.564 to 1.890 1.890 to 2.129 2.129 , with gains of + 0.197 / + 0.251 / + 0.211 +0.197/+0.251/+0.211 . Native visual pre-training is not decisive: Qwen3.5-27B, a general-purpose model, achieves the highest gain ( + 0.267 +0.267 ), while Qwen3-VL does not lead in Δ \Delta . Scaling therefore raises the performance ceiling but does not guarantee better image use, making evidence use an evaluation dimension independent of scale and modality architecture.
blocks.zh: 缩放提高了绝对质量,但证据的使用并不是单调的。 对于Wen3.5稠密系列(4B/9B/27B),多式联运的平均值从1.623 1.623升至1.785 1.785 2.171,而增益为+0.229 / + 0.225 / + 0.267+0.229/+0.225/+0.267;对于Quen3-VL(8B/32B/235B),其平均值从1.564 1.564升至1.890 1.890至2.129 2.129,增益为+0.197 / + 0.251/+0.211/+0.211. 原生视觉预训不具有决定性: Qwen3.5-27B,通用型号,实现最高增益(+0.267+0.267),而Qwen3-VL在QQ\Delta中并不领先. 因此,规模化提高了业绩上限,但并不能保证更好的图像使用,使证据使用评价层面独立于规模和模式结构。

blocks.en: Absolute quality and visual gain reveal different model bottlenecks. Gemini-3.1-pro (high) achieves 2.424 2.424 multimodal with only + 0.108 +0.108 gain; Qwen3.5-27B scores lower ( 2.171 2.171 ) but achieves the highest gain ( + 0.267 +0.267 ); GPT-5.6 achieves both the highest multimodal score ( 2.432 2.432 ) and a large gain ( + 0.211 +0.211 ). Lower baselines tend to yield larger Δ \Delta (see Table 5 ), so a large Δ \Delta may reflect effective image use or simply greater room for improvement. Thus, the multimodal score measures translation quality, while Δ \Delta measures how much vision closes the information gap, jointly distinguishing translation quality from visual reliance.
blocks.zh: 绝对质量和视觉收益揭示了不同的模型瓶颈. 双子座3.1-pro(高)实现2.424 2.424多式联运,只获得+0.108+0.108增益;Wen3.5-27B分数较低(2.171 2.171),但获得最高增益(+0.267+0.267);GPT-5.6同时实现最高的多式联运分数(2.432 2.432)和大增益(+0.211+0.211). 基线较低往往产生更大的QQ\德尔塔(见表5),因此一个大的QX\德尔塔可能反映有效的图像使用或者简单的更大的改进空间. 因此,多模式分数衡量翻译质量,而QQ\Delta衡量视觉能在多大程度上缩小信息差距,共同区分翻译质量和视觉依赖.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evidence-Attribution Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 证据归属分析

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Random-Image Control
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 随机图像控制

blocks.en: Because the type differences in the main results could still stem from an attention or prompting effect of an “extra modality,” we set up a Random Image condition that provides the translator with an image from another sample while keeping the prompt, model and judge unchanged, to test whether the gain requires the evidence to match the current sample.
blocks.zh: 由于主要结果的类型差异仍然可能源于“外模式”的注意或催化效应,我们设定了一个随机图像条件,向翻译提供来自另一个样本的图像,同时保持快速,模型和判断不变,以测试收益是否需要证据来匹配当前样本.

blocks.en: Mismatched evidence cannot substitute for missing evidence. On 4 4 representative configurations, the average change of random images over text-only is Symbol − 0.074 -0.074 , Visual − 0.005 -0.005 , Hybrid − 0.077 -0.077 (overall − 0.052 -0.052 ), whereas the same models with real images improve Visual and Hybrid by + 0.297 +0.297 and + 0.232 +0.232 . The main result is thus not a “one extra input modality” effect: models do read the image, but only visual evidence matching the current text can reconstruct the omitted contextual meaning, while a mismatched image is at best unhelpful and even introduces noise that distracts generation (Table 6 )—in sharp contrast to the visual-redundancy phenomenon of classic MMT, where randomly swapping the image is almost lossless.
blocks.zh: 错配的证据不能代替缺失的证据. 在4 4 个代表性配置中,随机图像比仅文本的平均变化是符号 − 0.074 - 0.074,视觉 − 0.005 - 0.005,混合 − 0.077 - 0.077(总体为 − 0.052 - 0.052),而具有真实图像的相同模型则通过 + 0.297 + 0.297和 + 0.232 + 0.232改进视觉和混合. 因此,主要结果不是"一个额外的输入模式"效应:模型确实读到了图像,而只有匹配当前文本的视觉证据才能重建省略的上下文含义,而不匹配的图像最多只能是无益的,甚至会引入干扰生成的噪音(表6)——与经典的MMT的视觉冗余现象形成鲜明对比,在这种现象中,随机交换图像几乎是毫无损失的.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 The Form of Visual Evidence
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 视觉证据的形式

blocks.en: The real-image condition requires a model to both recognize visual facts and use them for translation, and the two failures are hard to separate. The Human Caption condition directly provides human-verified visual facts, bypassing perception; comparing it with Text Only and Multimodal roughly distinguishes whether failure comes from “visual facts not recovered” or “facts obtained but target-language transfer not completed.” The judge input is kept identical across the three conditions.
blocks.zh: 真象条件要求一个模型既能识别视觉事实,又能用于翻译,两个失败很难分开. 人类特征条件直接提供经人验证的视觉事实,绕过感知;将其与"仅文本"(Text Only)和"多式联运"(Multimodule)作比较,大致区分失败是来自“未恢复的视觉事实”还是“获得但目标语言转移尚未完成的事实”。 在三个条件中,法官的投入保持不变。

blocks.en: Having visual facts available does not equal completing cultural transfer. On 4 representative configurations, the overall mean under Human Caption ( 2.201 2.201 ) is slightly higher than direct image reading ( 2.161 2.161 ), as is the score on Visual ( 2.316 2.316 vs. 2.242 2.242 ), suggesting that models may miss some task-relevant visual facts, but the gap is limited. Meanwhile, Hybrid under Human Caption reaches only 2.035 2.035 , below Visual’s 2.316 2.316 . Since the two groups are not strictly matched, this gap is not a pure causal estimate of cultural ability, but it shows that even with visual facts textualized, jointly dependent samples retain additional difficulty beyond what images can provide (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 掌握可视事实并不等于完成文化转移。 在4个代表性配置上,"人称"(2.201 2.201)下的总平均值略高于直接图像读数(2.161 2.161),视觉上的分数(2.316 2.316 vs 2.242 2.242)也是如此,暗示模型可能错过一些与任务相关的视觉事实,但差距有限. 与此同时,Human Caption下的混合体仅达到2.0352.035,低于Visual的2.3162.316. 由于这两个组没有严格匹配,这一差距并不是对文化能力的纯粹因果估计,但它表明,即使有了视觉事实的文字化,共同依赖的样本也保留了超出图像所能提供的额外难度(表6).

blocks.en: Together, the three interventions suggest three failure stages: inaccessible evidence, insufficient visual-fact recovery, and insufficient cultural-pragmatic transfer. Representative qualitative cases localizing errors to each bottleneck stage are illustrated in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 这三个干预加在一起表明三个失败阶段:无法获取证据、视觉-事实恢复不足以及文化-精神转移不足。 附录C说明了将错误定位到每个瓶颈阶段的有代表性的定性案例。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We move beyond the conventional view of whether images improve translation and argue that culturally effective social-media translation is fundamentally meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence . Culture-MMT uses three evidence-dependence types and controlled interventions to diagnose model failures across three stages: inaccessible evidence, insufficient fact recovery, and insufficient cultural adaptation. Experiments across 17 models show that visual perception and cultural knowledge are not interchangeable: the former recovers omitted facts, while the latter enables pragmatic adaptation. This perspective provides standardized evaluation and diagnostic tools for studying complex pragmatic representation in next-generation multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 我们超越了传统观点,认为图像是否改善翻译, Culture-MMT利用三种证据依赖类型和有控制的干预方法,诊断三个阶段的模型故障:无法获取的证据、事实恢复不足和文化适应不足。 跨越17种模型的实验表明,视觉感知和文化知识是不可互换的:前者省略了事实,而后者则能够进行务实的适应. 这一视角为研究下一代多式联运模式中复杂的务实代表性提供了标准化的评价和诊断工具。

blocks.en: 附录 A Related Work
blocks.zh: ○ 相关工作

blocks.en: A.1 Multimodal Machine Translation
blocks.zh: A.1 多式联运

blocks.en: Multimodal machine translation (MMT) leverages visual context to mitigate textual ambiguity ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Hatami et al., 2025 ) . However, standard benchmarks assume semantically self-contained text, leading prior work to question the necessity of vision ( Futeral et al., 2025 ; Kumar et al., 2025 ; Xiong and Zhao, 2025 ) . While recent studies incorporate cultural awareness and visual grounding ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Villa-Cueva et al., 2025 ; Satar et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , they conflate multimodal perception with cultural understanding. In contrast, Culture-MMT reframes UGC translation as meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence . Crucially, visual fact recovery and cultural adaptation represent distinct, non-interchangeable bottlenecks: accessing visual facts does not guarantee pragmatic adequacy. Through evidence-dependency categorization and controlled interventions, Culture-MMT systematically disentangles model failures across evidence access, visual grounding, and cultural transfer.
blocks.zh: 多式机器翻译(MMT)利用视觉上下文减轻文字上的模糊性(Feng等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年;Hatami等人,2025年)。 然而,标准基准假定案文自成一体,导致先前的工作质疑视力的必要性(Futeral等人,2025年;Kumar等人,2025年;Xiong和Zhao,2025年)。 虽然最近的研究纳入了文化意识和视觉基础(姚等人,2024年;袁等人,2026年;Villa-Cueva等人,2025年;Satar等人,2025年;周等人,2025年),但它们将多式联运观念与文化理解结合起来。 反之, Culture-MMT将UGC翻译重新设定为来自分布式证据的重建。 关键的是,视觉事实恢复和文化适应代表着独特的、不可互换的瓶颈:获取视觉事实并不能保证实际的充分性。 通过证据依赖性分类和有控制的干预,文化-MMT系统将模型的失败分解于证据获取、视觉定位和文化转移。

blocks.en: A.2 Culture-Aware and UGC Translation
blocks.zh: A.2 文化意识和UGC翻译

blocks.en: Recent studies investigate cultural awareness in text-only translation ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025b ) and extend it to multimodal contexts through visual grounding and meme transcreation ( Villa-Cueva et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . In user-generated content (UGC), however, prior work largely focuses on colloquial noise or multimodal dialogue ( Michel and Neubig, 2018 ; Liang et al., 2022 ) , while cultural benchmarks like Culture-MT ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) assume the source text is semantically self-contained. In contrast, we extend cultural evaluation to visually dependent UGC where essential meaning is omitted from text. By introducing Symbol as a text-only control and applying controlled evidence conditions, Culture-MMT systematically disentangles visual fact recovery from cultural adaptation.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究调查了仅用文字翻译的文化意识(姚等人,2024年;袁等人,2026年;廖等人,2025年;郭等人,2025年b),并通过视觉地面和memem转基因将文化意识推广到多模式环境(Villa-Cueva等人,2025年;Pan等人,2026年;赵等人,2026年;郑等人,2025年). 然而在用户生成的内容(UGC)中,之前的工作主要侧重于口语噪声或多模式对话(Michel and Neubig, 2018;Liang等人, 2022),而Culture-MT(Wu等人, 2026;Qiu等人, 2026)等文化基准则假设源文本自成一体. 反之,我们把文化评价扩大到视觉依赖的UGC,在文本中忽略了基本意义。 Culture-MMT通过引入符号作为文本唯一的控制,并应用受控制的证据条件,系统地将视觉事实从文化适应中分离出来。

blocks.en: 附录 B Limitations
blocks.zh: B. 限制

blocks.en: Language and Cultural Scope. Culture-MMT focuses exclusively on the Chinese-to-English direction. Although the theoretical framework of distributed evidence is generalizable to other high-context online communication, Chinese social media exhibits highly specific cultural memes and elliptical patterns. Validating whether the observed evidence-utilization trends generalize to other typologically distinct language pairs and cultural spaces remains future work.
blocks.zh: 语言与文化范围. Culture-MMT专注中英文方向. 虽然分布式证据的理论框架可以概括到其他高文本在线通信中,但中国社交媒体展现出高度具体的文化迷因和椭圆模式. 验证观察到的证据利用趋势是否概括到其他类型不同的语言对和文化空间,仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Sample Granularity across Domains and Mechanisms. With 498 curated notes (166 per evidence cell), our benchmark provides sufficient rigor for macro-level comparisons across the three dependency types. However, its statistical power is limited for finer-grained sub-analyses across the 20 verticals or visual grounding mechanisms (e.g., OCR text, scene disambiguation, and cultural metaphors).
blocks.zh: 跨域和机制的颗粒性样本。 有了498个注释(每个证据单元166个),我们的基准就足以在宏观一级对三种依赖类型进行比较。 然而,它对于跨越20个垂直或视觉地基机制(如OCR文本,场景混沌,以及文化比喻)的细微分分析的统计力量有限.

blocks.en: Evaluation Ceiling of Textual Proxies. To prevent perceptual errors and hallucinations of multimodal judges from confounding evaluation, our Judger evaluates translations against human-verified textual descriptions rather than raw images. While this protocol ensures reproducible and controlled scoring across conditions, it inherently shifts the evaluation ceiling to the descriptive granularity of human annotations—subtle visual nuances omitted in the captions cannot be credited.
blocks.zh: 文字代用品评价上限。 为了防止多式联运法官的观念错误和幻觉混淆评价,我们的法官根据经人验证的文字描述而不是原始图像来评价翻译。 虽然这项协议确保了可复制和可控制的评分,但从本质上讲,它把评价的上限转移到人类说明的描述性颗粒性上——在标题中省略的微小视觉细微差别是不能抵免的。

blocks.zh: C 模式失败案例

Each panel juxtaposes the source image-text, model translations under different evidence conditions, and an error note, allowing the bottleneck to be localized to a specific stage.

页:1 5:多式联运三种有代表性的失败模式:(a)视觉证据识别,(b)跨模式证据整合,(c)文化转移和目标语言表达. 标有“*”的栏是基准信息;

blocks.en: Failure-mode descriptions. (a) Visual-evidence recognition failure occurs when the model fails to recover a key visual fact needed for translation. Here, the multimodal model renders “小黄帽” as the ambiguous “little yellow caps”, while the correct expression is “little yellow keycaps”. The human-caption condition resolves the error, indicating that the bottleneck is failure to recognize the objects as keyboard keycaps.
blocks.zh: 失败模式描述. (a) 当模型未能恢复翻译所需的关键视觉事实时,即发生视觉证据识别失败。 此处,多式联运模式将“小黄帽”作为模棱两可的“小黄盖”,而正确的表述是“小黄盖”。 人封装条件解决了错误,表明瓶颈是无法识别物体为键盘键盖.

blocks.en: (b) Cross-modal evidence-integration failure occurs when the model recognizes the visual fact but fails to align it with an elliptical or referential expression in the text. Here, “这颗蛋” remains “this egg”, whereas the intended meaning is “this strawberry Eggy character”. The human-caption condition does not resolve the error, suggesting that the visual fact is available but is not correctly integrated with the textual reference.
blocks.zh: (b) 当模型承认视觉事实但未能使其与文本中的椭圆或偏好表达一致时,即发生跨模式证据-整合失败。 这里,“这颗蛋”仍为“这个蛋”,而原意是“这个草莓Eggy特性”。 人类封装条件不能解决错误,说明视觉事实是可以得到的,但并没有与文字参考正确结合.

blocks.en: (c) Cultural-transfer and target-language-expression failure occurs when the model recovers the visual fact and source meaning but fails to express them naturally in the target language. Here, the rounded heel of the shoes is translated as the awkward “round closed heel”, whereas “rounded heel counter” is more precise and natural. This indicates a bottleneck in target-language terminology and cultural-pragmatic expression.
blocks.zh: (c) 文化转移和目标语言表达失败发生在模型恢复视觉事实和源含义但未能以目标语言自然表达时。 在这里,四舍五入的鞋跟被译为尴尬的“圆闭足跟”,而“四舍五入足跟柜台”则更为准确和自然。 这表明在目标语言术语和文化形式上存在瓶颈。

blocks.en: 附录 D Evaluation Protocol and Full Prompts
blocks.zh: +D 评价协议和全部提示

blocks.en: D.1 Why the Judge Needs Visual Evidence
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 为什么法官需要视觉证据

blocks.en:
We assess cultural effectiveness with the domain-specialized Judger we train (on aQwen3.5-27B ( Team, 2026 ) base). Unlike a generic LLM-as-a-judge ( Fu and Liu, 2025 ) , this task additionally requires the judge to
determine whether a translation recovers information carried by the image but not made explicit in the text. If the judge saw only the source text, it might misjudge a correct visual completion as an unfounded addition; and if different translator conditions corresponded to different judge evidence, the change of evaluation condition would be confounded. We therefore fix the judge input
across all translator conditions: the Judger always receives the same human-verified image description, fixing the judge’s basis on the sample’s attributes so that between-group differences correspond to the evidence the translator can access. The agreement of the Judger with human scoring and the comparison results are given in 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们通过我们培训的域专门法官(在Quen3.5-27B(团队,2026年)基地)来评估文化效力。 与一般LLM-as-a法官不同(Fu和Liu,2025年),这项任务还要求法官:
确定译文是否恢复图像所携带但文本中未明确的信息。 如果法官只看到来源文本,它可能会误判正确的视觉完成是毫无根据的添加;如果不同的翻译条件与不同的法官证据相对应,则评价条件的改变会令人困惑. 因此我们确定法官的意见
跨越所有翻译条件:法官总是得到同样的经人验证的图像描述,根据样本的属性确定法官的基础,以便组别之间的差异与翻译可以获取的证据相符。 法官同意人评分和比较结果载于3.3。

blocks.en: D.2 Translator Input Conditions and the Full Prompt
blocks.zh: D.2 翻译输入条件和全速

blocks.en:
The four translator conditions share the same translation instruction and change only the accessible visual evidence. Text Only inputs only the title and body to be translated, with no visual information attached; Multimodal inputs the real image of the current note through the model’s native image part; Random Image inputs an unrelated image from another sample; Human Caption places the human-verified Chinese image description before
the content to be translated and explicitly marks it as auxiliary evidence that need not be translated. Apart from the form of the evidence, the prompt structure and output requirements are identical across conditions. The full translator prompt used in the experiments is given below.
blocks.zh:
四个翻译条件共用相同的翻译指令,只更改可获取的视觉证据. 文字 只输入要翻译的标题和正体, 没有附加视觉信息 ; 多式联运通过模型的原生图像部分输入当前音符的真实图像 ; 随机图像输入另一个样本中不相关的图像 ; 人类字幕将人验证的中国图像描述放置在前面 。
将翻译的内容明确标记为不需要翻译的辅助证据。 除了证据的形式之外,迅速的结构和产出要求在各种条件下是相同的。 实验中使用的全翻译提示如下.

blocks.en: Translator prompt (shared across all conditions) You are a multilingual translation expert specialized in translating Chinese user-generated social media content into English. Please translate the following [CONTENT] from Chinese into English. Important instructions: 1. Placeholders in the form of #占位x# must not be translated. Preserve each placeholder exactly and keep it in the corresponding position in the translated text. 2. Output only the translated result. Do not include any additional content, notes, or explanations. 3. Preserve all structural tags such as <title></title>, <content></content>, etc., and output the translation using the same format. 4. The source text is user-generated social media content. The translation should: - Faithfully preserve the original emotional tone (e.g., excitement, sarcasm, complaint, humor, irony). - Sound natural and idiomatic to native English speakers on social platforms. - Avoid overly formal, academic, or literal phrasing. 5. When the original text contains culture-specific expressions, slang, or implicit context that may not be immediately clear to English readers: - Translate them into an equivalent expression that conveys the same intent and emotion. - Do not add explanations or annotations. 6. Do not introduce information unsupported by the source post. Information grounded in the accompanying images is part of the source post and may be made explicit when necessary for a faithful translation. Do not omit emotionally or pragmatically important details or structure. The [CONTENT] to be translated is as follows: {content} Please provide the translated result:
blocks.zh: 翻译及时( 在所有条件下共享) 您是多语言翻译专家, 请将以下[CONTENT]从中文译为英文. 重要指示: 1. 不得翻译QQx#形式的占位符。 保存每个占位符的准确性,并保留在翻译文本中相应的位置. 2. 只输出翻译结果。 不包括任何补充内容、说明或解释。 3. 保存所有结构标记,如<title></title>,<content></content>等,并使用相同的格式输出翻译。 4. 来源文本是用户生成的社交媒体内容。 译文应: - 忠实地保留原情感基调(如兴奋,讽刺,抱怨,幽默,讽刺). - 在社交平台上对讲英语的本地人发出自然和异乎寻常的声音。 - 避免过于正式、学术性或文字性的措辞。 5. 当原文中包含文化特有的表达方式、语义或隐含的语境,而英语读者可能无法立即明白: - 将其译为表达相同意图和情感的同等表达方式。 不添加解释或说明。 6. 不要引入未经消息来源支持的信息。 以所附图像为基础的信息是来源文章的一部分,必要时可以明确无误地翻译。 不要省略情感或务实的重要细节或结构。 拟翻译的[CONTENT]如下: {内容} 请提供翻译结果:

blocks.en: D.3 Judge Training, Input Organization, and Full Prompt
blocks.zh: D.3 法官培训、投入组织和全速

blocks.en:
Judger training. The Judger is built on a Qwen3.5-27B base. We collect source text from public social-media platforms and use multiple translation models to construct about 300 300 K source–translation pairs covering different quality levels, of which about 200 200 K are labeled by Gemini and 100 100 K by humans. Training has three stages: first, supervised fine-tuning
on 150 150 K samples balanced across the 0 0 – 3 3 scale drawn from the Gemini-labeled pool; then continued fine-tuning on 40 40 K balanced human-labeled samples; finally GRPO on 20 20 K samples drawn from the human-labeled pool, further aligning the judge with human evaluation. At inference it is deployed via vLLM on 8 8 × \times 80 80 GB NVIDIA H800 GPUs with 8 8 -way tensor parallelism ( tp = 8 \mathrm{tp}=8 ).
blocks.zh:
法官培训。 法官座堂以Quen3.5-27B为基础。 我们从公共社交媒体平台收集源文本,并使用多种翻译模型构建大约300K源–翻译对,覆盖不同质量级别,其中约200200K被双子座标注,100100K被人类标注. 培训分为三个阶段:第一,监督微调
150K样本 平衡 0 – 3 标尺 从双子标注池中抽取; 然后继续微调 40 K 平衡的人类标注样本; 最后 GPRO 对20 K 标尺从人类标注池中抽取,进一步使裁判与人类评价一致. 推论它通过vLLM在8 8 ×\times 80 GB NVIDIA H800 GPU上部署,有8 8 - way radio 并行(tp = 8\mathrm{tp}=8 ).

blocks.en:
The Judger rates a translation on a 0 0 – 3 3 scale for semantic accuracy, linguistic naturalness and cultural fit: 0 0 means serious errors with core semantics not conveyed; 1 1 means the main idea is recognizable but there are clear mistranslations, omissions or expression problems; 2 2 means the main information is accurate and grammar is largely correct, but there is
slight unnaturalness, cultural infelicity or stylistic weakening; 3 3 means accurate semantics, natural expression and fit to the English social-media context ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Beyond the overall score, the
prompt specifies format constraints, eight error types, three severity levels, a structured output format and three scoring examples. For image-dependent samples, the judge reads the human-verified Chinese image description, the Chinese source and the English translation simultaneously, and uses the image description to judge whether the translation recovers visual information not explicit in
the text. The image description states only task-relevant visual facts and contains no answer to the translation point; all translator conditions use exactly the same judge input, keeping the scoring basis consistent.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Judge prompt (original Chinese, used in all experiments) 你是一个精通中英双语、熟悉网络文化且极为严厉的翻译质量评估专家。你的任务是根据给定的上下文、原文和译文，按照以下严格的规则和格式进行评估。 1. 评分要求： 语义准确性核心要求： * 正确理解原文语义及情感：译文需准确反映原文的字面意思和隐含情感（如讽刺、兴奋、沮丧）。 * 文化适应性称呼翻译：对”姐妹”、”老师”、”宝子”等称呼的翻译需考虑文化背景和社交礼仪，不能存在冒犯或歧义。 * 符合目标文化语境：译文需符合英语文化语境和目标受众（社交媒体用户）的阅读习惯，避免中式英语。 * 文化负载词处理：对承载特定文化、网络或语境含义的词汇（如”绝绝子”、”种草”），直译无法理解的，必须进行意译或文化替换，不可直译。 * 单位换算准确性：涉及中式单位（如”亩”、”斤”、”里”）与国际单位的换算时，需准确并明确限定范围，避免歧义；对于中文习惯省略的单位，译文中需补充完整。 * 专有名词准确性：对著名人名、地名、品牌名、作品名等特殊名词，要求翻译准确或使用公认译名。 * 图文依赖判定：本条【上下文】中的『配图内容(人工精标caption)』是人工对图片内容的精标中文描述（任务导向、可能有损，并非原图本身）。评判时：(1)若译文未能体现只有借助图片才能得到的正确义项（把仅凭图片可知的意思翻错、漏译或泛化成通用词），按语义偏差从严扣分；(2)译文正确补出图中承载的信息属于应得的正确翻译，不得因『中文原文字面没写』而反扣分。 格式要求（一旦违反立即判0分）： * #占位x# 是不能翻译的，否则直接0分 * 翻译前后<comment></comment> <title></title> <content></content>等标签无法对应，这意味着翻译结果无法正确被提取，违反这条直接0分 2. 评分标准： 你需要为整篇翻译给出一个 0到3分 的总体分数，定义如下： * 0分：译文有严重错误，无法传递原文语义或内容丢失/曲解。 * 1分：译文存在明显问题，但主要语义尚可被艰难理解。存在关键错误或文化误译，严重影响阅读体验。 * 2分：译文准确传达了原文的主要信息，语法基本正确，但存在表达不地道、轻微文化不适或文体功能弱化等问题。 * 3分：译文精准、表达自然、符合英语文化语境，语法规范，传达原文的所有信息，符合英语社交平台受众的阅读习惯。 3. 错误类型： * 专有名词（著名专有名词，非著名专有名词）， * 特殊名词（固定称谓，特殊词汇）， * 语义偏差（标题主语缺失，符号遗漏/错误，微弱语法错误，文本增加/遗漏，语气不自然）， * 直译（直译，句子结构不地道，用词不准）， * 上下文缺失（原文有异议/不明确）， * 单位（单位增加，单位换算）， * 长文本（长文本专有名词，长文本翻译）， * 其他（中英夹杂，表情符号，政治，安全） 4. 严重程度： * 严重：表示扭曲句意 * 中等：表示影响语义，但仍可被理解 * 一般：表示有错误，但语义影响不大 5. 输出格式： 对整句的翻译意见：xxx 问题1：xxx 对问题1的评论：xxx 问题1类型：（一级标签）-（二级标签） 问题1严重程度：xxx 问题2：xxx 对问题2的评论：xxx 问题2类型：（一级标签）-（二级标签） 问题2严重程度：xxx 最终分数：（只有数字） 重要格式规则说明： * 如果翻译完美，则只输出‘对整句的翻译意见：无问题可指出‘和‘最终分数：3‘。 * 如果有一个或多个问题，必须在‘对整句的翻译意见‘后，按顺序列出所有问题。 * ‘对整句的翻译意见‘字段不能为空，需要一个总结性地说明。 6. 评估示例： * 示例1： 可参考的上下文：0.第一次看鸟片好紧张 1.#手养鹦鹉[话题]# #玄凤鹦鹉[话题]# #合法饲养[话题]# 尊滴好尴尬 2.昨天我家的狗子被不认识的大狼狗给那啥了，那狗比我家狗足足大了2倍，看到的时候已经屁股对着屁股了，我老公说这时候不能去动他们，不然会出不来，受伤的，我家狗2条后腿都悬空着的[惊恐R] 原文：<comment3>必须引产，生不出来，太危险</comment3> 译文：<comment3>An abortion is necessary, it can’t be born, it’s too dangerous.</comment3> 输出： 对整句的翻译意见：译文存在医学概念翻译的错误，导致语义误解。 问题1：An abortion is necessary 对问题1的评论：”引产”是指人工诱发分娩以使胎儿存活，应译为”induced labor”或”an induction is necessary”。而”abortion”指终止妊娠，两者含义相反，此处为严重误译。 and AI experience are all getting a major upgrade. And there’s more to come! See you at the launch on February 20th at 7:00 PM! 对整句的翻译意见：无问题可指出 最终分数：3 * 示例3: 可参考的上下文：无 原文：<title>姐妹们快冲！这款面膜真的绝了！</title> 译文：<title>Sisters, go quickly! This facial mask is really absolute.</title> 输出： 对整句的翻译意见：译文生硬直译，严重削弱了原文的号召力和情感色彩。 问题1：go quickly! This facial mask is really absolute. 对问题1的评论：”快冲！”在此处是强烈的购买建议，应译为”Run, don’t walk!”或”You gotta get this!”。”绝了”表示极好，应译为”amazing”、”incredible”或”the best”。当前译法完全不符合英语种草文案的表达习惯。 问题1类型：直译-用词不准 问题1严重程度：中等 问题2：Sisters 对问题2的评论：在非特定语境下，”姐妹们”作为一种亲切呼语，译为”Sisters”略显生硬。根据上下文，可简化为”Guys”或”Everyone”，或直接省略。 问题2类型：特殊名词-特殊词汇 问题2严重程度：一般 最终分数：1 请你根据上述提示，对这个翻译内容以规定的格式进行评估，仅输出评估内容，不要输出其他无关内容。 以下是你要评估的内容： {content} 输出：

blocks.en: Judge prompt (English translation, for reference only) You are a translation-quality assessment expert who is fluent in both Chinese and English, familiar with internet culture, and extremely strict. Your task is to evaluate the given context, source text and translation according to the following strict rules and format. 1. Scoring requirements: Core requirements for semantic accuracy: * Correctly understand the source semantics and emotion: the translation must accurately reflect the literal meaning and the implicit emotion of the source (e.g., sarcasm, excitement, frustration). * Culturally appropriate translation of address terms: translating terms of address such as ”sister”, ”teacher”, ”bao-zi (dear)” must consider cultural background and social etiquette, and must not be offensive or ambiguous. * Fit to the target cultural context: the translation must fit the English cultural context and the reading habits of the target audience (social-media users), avoiding Chinglish. * Handling of culture-loaded words: for words carrying specific cultural, internet or contextual meaning (e.g., ”jue-jue-zi (amazing)”, ”zhong-cao (recommend/plant a desire)”), when a literal translation is not understandable, paraphrase or cultural substitution is mandatory; literal translation is not allowed. * Accuracy of unit conversion: when Chinese units (e.g., ”mu”, ”jin”, ”li”) are involved, convert to international units accurately and with a clearly bounded range to avoid ambiguity; for units that Chinese habitually omits, complete them in the translation. * Accuracy of proper nouns: for special nouns such as famous person names, place names, brand names and work titles, the translation must be accurate or use the accepted rendering. * Image-text dependency judgment: the ”image content (human fine-labeled caption)” in the [Context] is a human, task-oriented, possibly lossy Chinese description of the image (not the original image itself). When judging: (i) if the translation fails to reflect the correct sense obtainable only via the image (mistranslating, omitting, or over-generalizing into a generic word a meaning that is knowable only from the image), deduct strictly as a semantic deviation; (ii) the translation correctly supplying information carried by the image counts as a deserved correct translation and must not be penalized on the grounds that ”the Chinese source does not state it literally”. Format requirements (any violation immediately scores 0): * #placeholder-x# must not be translated; otherwise score 0 directly. * If tags such as <comment></comment> <title></title> <content></content> before and after translation cannot be matched, the translation result cannot be correctly extracted; violating this scores 0 directly. 2. Scoring scale: You must give one overall score from 0 to 3 for the whole translation, defined as follows: * 0: the translation has serious errors and fails to convey the source semantics, or content is lost/distorted. * 1: the translation has obvious problems, but the main semantics can be understood with difficulty. There are key errors or cultural mistranslations that seriously harm the reading experience. * 2: the translation accurately conveys the main information of the source and grammar is largely correct, but there is unidiomatic expression, slight cultural inappropriateness, or weakened stylistic function. * 3: the translation is precise, natural, fits the English cultural context, is grammatically correct, conveys all information of the source, and matches the reading habits of English social-platform audiences. 3. Error types: * Proper nouns (famous proper nouns, non-famous proper nouns), * Special nouns (fixed address terms, special vocabulary), * Semantic deviation (missing title subject, symbol omission/error, minor grammatical error, text addition/omission, unnatural tone), * Literal translation (literal translation, unidiomatic sentence structure, inaccurate wording), * Missing context (source is disputable/unclear), * Units (unit addition, unit conversion), * Long text (long-text proper nouns, long-text translation), * Other (Chinese-English code-mixing, emoji, politics, safety) 4. Severity levels: * Serious: distorts the sentence meaning. * Medium: affects the semantics but can still be understood. * Minor: there is an error, but the semantic impact is small. 5. Output format: Translation comment on the whole sentence: xxx Problem 1: xxx Comment on problem 1: xxx Problem 1 type: (level-1 tag)-(level-2 tag) Problem 1 severity: xxx Problem 2: xxx Comment on problem 2: xxx Problem 2 type: (level-1 tag)-(level-2 tag) Problem 2 severity: xxx Final score: (number only) Important formatting rules: * If the translation is perfect, output only ‘Translation comment on the whole sentence: no problem to point out‘ and ‘Final score: 3‘. * If there are one or more problems, after ‘Translation comment on the whole sentence‘ list all problems in order. * The ‘Translation comment on the whole sentence‘ field must not be empty; it needs a summarizing statement. 6. Scoring examples: * Example 1: Reference context: 0. So nervous watching a bird video for the first time 1. #hand-raised parrot[topic]# #cockatiel[topic]# #legal keeping[topic]# so embarrassing 2. Yesterday my dog was, you know, mounted by a big unfamiliar wolfdog, a dog a full 2x bigger than mine; by the time I saw it they were already rear-to-rear. My husband said you can’t pull them apart at this moment or they’ll get hurt and won’t come loose; both of my dog’s hind legs were dangling in the air [terrified R] Source: <comment3>必须引产，生不出来，太危险</comment3> Translation: <comment3>An abortion is necessary, it can’t be born, it’s too dangerous.</comment3> Output: Translation comment on the whole sentence: the translation has a medical-concept error that leads to a semantic misunderstanding. Problem 1: An abortion is necessary Comment on problem 1: ”引产” means inducing labor artificially so that the fetus is delivered alive, and should be translated as ”induced labor” or ”an induction is necessary”. ”abortion” means terminating the pregnancy; the two have opposite meanings, so this is a serious mistranslation here. Problem 1 type: Literal translation-inaccurate wording Problem 1 severity: Serious Final score: 0 * Example 2: Reference context: none Source: #OPPOFindN5 Feel, battery life, performance, waterproofing, fast charging and the AI experience are all comprehensively upgraded. More surprises—see you at the Feb 20, 19:00 launch! Translation: #OPPOFindN5 The feel, battery life, performance, water resistance, fast charging, and AI experience are all getting a major upgrade. And there’s more to come! See you at the launch on February 20th at 7:00 PM! Translation comment on the whole sentence: no problem to point out Final score: 3 * Example 3: Reference context: none Source: <title>姐妹们快冲！这款面膜真的绝了！</title> Translation: <title>Sisters, go quickly! This facial mask is really absolute.</title> Output: Translation comment on the whole sentence: the translation is stiff and literal, seriously weakening the source’s call-to-action and emotional color. Problem 1: go quickly! This facial mask is really absolute. Comment on problem 1: ”快冲！” here is a strong buying suggestion and should be translated as ”Run, don’t walk!” or ”You gotta get this!”. ”绝了” means excellent and should be translated as ”amazing”, ”incredible” or ”the best”. The current rendering does not match the expression habits of English recommendation copy. Problem 1 type: Literal translation-inaccurate wording Problem 1 severity: Medium Problem 2: Sisters Comment on problem 2: in a non-specific context, ”姐妹们” as an affectionate form of address is a bit stiff when rendered as ”Sisters”. Depending on context, it can be simplified to ”Guys” or ”Everyone”, or dropped entirely. Problem 2 type: Special nouns-special vocabulary Problem 2 severity: Minor Final score: 1 Following the above instructions, evaluate this translation in the specified format; output only the evaluation content and nothing else. The content to be evaluated is as follows: {content} Output:

<title></title> <content></content>等标签,则翻译结果无法正确提取;直接违反此分数0. 2. 计分尺度: 您必须给整个翻译一个0到3的总分,定义如下: *0:翻译有严重错误,无法传达源语义,或内容丢失/扭曲. *1:译文存在明显的问题,但主要语义可以难以理解. 有些关键错误或文化上的错译严重影响了阅读体验. blocks.en: 附录 E Benchmark Construction and Privacy Protection
blocks.zh: E 基准建设和隐私保护

blocks.en: E.1 Real-UGC Candidate Collection and Normalization
blocks.zh: E.1 实际UGC 候选人的收集和正常化

blocks.en:
The candidates of Culture-MMT come from real Chinese social-media UGC, collected in multiple non-overlapping time windows. We normalize the title, body, image and vertical fields, keep the static frames of video notes that can carry translation evidence, and remove samples with missing images, corrupted files or unusable text. A multimodal model generates an image description, text-only and multimodal draft translations, and a temporary evidence-dependency and vertical
label for each candidate to improve filtering efficiency; these results are auxiliary only, the final type is decided by humans, and the drafts do not enter the released data. After candidate filtering, differential verification, privacy-preserving rewriting and sealing-stage quality control, the released set contains 498 498 notes covering 20 20 verticals.
blocks.zh:
Culture-MMT的候选人来自真实的中国社交媒体UGC,收集在多个不重叠的时间窗口中. 我们使标题、身体、图像和垂直字段正常化,保留可以携带翻译证据的视频笔记的静态帧,并删除缺少图像、损坏文件或无法使用的文本的样本。 多式联运模式生成图像描述、仅文本和多式联运翻译草稿以及临时证据依赖和纵向
给每个候选者贴上标签以提高过滤效率;这些结果只是辅助性的,最终类型由人类决定,草稿不输入发布的数据. 在候选过滤,差分校验,隐私保留重写和封存阶段质量控制之后,发行的套装包含498 498个笔记,涵盖20个垂直.

blocks.en: E.2 Candidate Filtering and Differential Verification
blocks.zh: E.2 候选人过滤和区别核查

blocks.en:
The filtering stage aims to obtain the three evidence-dependency types separately. The first stage is a feature-based coarse filter with no LLM call: keeping only samples of length 5 5 – 30 30 characters containing Chinese characters, removing catch-all phrases (e.g., “thanks / so cute /
amazing”) and templated content and discarding the Easy tier, then keeping, by regular-expression features (code-switching, elided reference, named entities, visual signals), candidates with a visual dependency or a strong textual signal, and filtering out pure cultural-symbol noise. The second stage performs differential verification on Visual and Hybrid candidates: a Gemini
multimodal model generates an image text description, a text-only translation and a multimodal translation, and our text Judger (a 0 0 – 3 3 scale, the same scoring rubric as the main experiment’s judge) scores the two translations under the same image-description context; when the score difference of the multimodal translation over the text-only translation reaches the threshold ( gap ≥ 1 \mathrm{gap}\geq 1 ), the candidate enters human re-review, sorted by descending gap.
Symbol candidates are not retained by visual gain, but are confirmed by humans to require internet-culture knowledge while not depending on the image. As one measured round: 2,000 2{,}000 candidates leave 1,485 1{,}485 after the first stage, 312 312 after the second stage ( gap ≥ 1 \mathrm{gap}\geq 1 ), and 75 75 after human re-review; the final label of each round is decided by humans, and automatic filtering is used only to improve candidate-enrichment efficiency. blocks.zh:
过滤阶段旨在分别获得三种证据依赖类型。 第一阶段是一个基于特征的粗滤波器,没有LLM调用:只保留长度5 5 – 30个字符的样本,包含中文字符,删除了包罗万象的短语(如"thanks / so cute /").
并且将内容模板化并丢弃Easy层级,然后通过正则表达功能(代码切换,缩放引用,命名实体,视觉信号),具有视觉依赖性或强烈的文字信号的候选者,并过滤出纯文化符号噪声. 第二阶段对视觉和混合型候选人进行差异核查:双子座

blocks.en: E.3 Privacy-Preserving Rewriting Protocol
blocks.zh: E.3 隐私保留改写协议

blocks.en:
All studied phenomena and candidate instances derive from real UGC, but the original posts may contain identifiable people, entities, places and reverse-retrievable visual details, so each is rewritten for privacy before release. The rewrite preserves the vertical, social-media register,
narrative function, evidence-dependency type and core translation point of the original, while replacing people, nicknames, numbers, brands, plot details and surface visual elements that could lead to identification or content traceback. The title, body and image are rewritten jointly, so that the released sample is still an internally consistent, natural UGC note. Each sample uses a
translation-point ledger to record the source expression, target meaning, evidence carrier, clues that must be preserved and shortcuts that must not be introduced, serving as a shared constraint for rewriting and acceptance.
blocks.zh:
所有被研究的现象和候选实例都来源于真实的UGC,但原始的帖子可能包含可识别的人,实体,地点和可逆检索的视觉细节,因此在发布前每个都为隐私重写. 重写保留垂直的社交媒体登记册,
叙事功能,证据依赖类型和原作的核心翻译点,同时替换人,昵称,数字,品牌,情节细节和表面视觉元素,可以导致识别或内容追溯. 标题,躯体和图像都是共同改写的,这样发布的样本仍然是内部一致的,自然的UGC注释. 每个样本使用一个
翻译点分类账可以记录源表达式,目标含义,证据载体,必须保存的线索和不能引入的快捷键,成为重写和接受的共享约束.

blocks.en:
The ledger records five fields per translation point: the source expression (a word, phrase or elided reference in the original), the target meaning (the meaning the English translation must express), the evidence carrier (one of text-only, image, or image-and-text jointly required), the clues that must be preserved (the minimal contextual signal that must survive the rewrite), and the
shortcuts that must not be introduced (any change that would make the answer explicit or easier to produce).
blocks.zh:
分类账记录了每个翻译点的五个字段:源表达式(原文中一个单词,短语或缩放的参考物),目标含义(英文翻译必须表达的意思),证据载体(共同需要的仅文本,图像,或图像和文本之一),必须保存的线索(在重写后必须存活的最小背景信号),以及
不得引入的快捷键(使答案明确或更容易生成的任何改动)。

blocks.en: 表 7: Four image-rewriting strategies.
blocks.zh: 联合国 7:四种图像重写策略.

blocks.en:
Images are rewritten with one of four strategies according to their role in the translation point (Table 7 ). For real-scene and public-figure images, we preserve the recognizability of the task-relevant subject or scene while changing composition, viewpoint and
non-key details; for in-image text and generic scenes, we regenerate semantically equivalent text or fictional people and objects. All images are generated with gpt-image-2 and pass a perceptual-hash and structural-similarity check, ensuring the released image is sufficiently separated from the source at the visual surface while retaining the evidence needed to complete the translation.
blocks.zh:
图像根据它们在翻译点的作用,用四个策略之一重写(表7). 对于真实的场景和公共图象,我们保留与任务相关的主题或场景的可识别性,同时改变组成、观点和
非关键细节;对于内映文本和通用场景,我们再生出等效文本或虚构人物和对象. 所有图像都是用gpt-image-2生成的,并通过感知-hash和结构-simility检查,确保释放的图像在视觉表面与源充分分离,同时保留完成翻译所需的证据.

blocks.en: E.4 Rewriting and Acceptance Constraints
blocks.zh: E.4 改写和接受限制

blocks.en:
Privacy-preserving rewriting has three steps: generation, independent acceptance and necessary revision. Rewriting is constrained by the translation-point ledger: the cultural expression in Symbol must not be explanatorily unpacked, the key meaning of Visual must still depend on
the image, and the cultural and visual evidence of Hybrid must both hold; the title, body and image must be updated jointly and remain naturally consistent, while elements that could point to a real identity or the original post are replaced. Each sample also retains its rewriting strategy, evidence-preservation status and privacy-check record to support later re-review.
blocks.zh:
隐私保留重写有三个步骤:生成,独立接受和必要的修改. 重写受到翻译点分类账的限制:符号中的文化表达语不得被解开,视觉的关键含义仍必须依赖于
图像,以及混合体的文化和视觉证据必须同时持有;标题、身体和图像必须共同更新,并自然保持一致性,同时可以指向真实身份或原始职位的元素被替换。 每个样本还保留其重写策略,证据保存状态和隐私检查记录,以支持日后的重审.

blocks.en:
Text rewriting keeps the original language, social-media register and the implicitness level of each translation point, does not explain the cultural expression in the body, and does not turn a Visual sample into one answerable from text alone. Identifiable identities and private
attributes are replaced with fictional, non-specific content; sentence patterns, narrative angle and characteristic phrases are sufficiently rewritten to reduce surface similarity to the source post while keeping natural UGC expression.
blocks.zh:
文本重写保留了原始语言,社交媒体的注册和每个翻译点的隐含程度,不解释体内的文化表达,也不将一个视觉样本从单文本变成一个答案. 可识别身份和私人身份
属性被虚构的,非特定的内容所取代;句子模式,叙事角度和特征短语被充分改写,以减少表面与源句的相似性,同时保持自然的UGC表达.

blocks.en: Rewritten samples undergo independent acceptance, focusing on whether the evidence-dependency type is preserved, whether image and text are consistent, whether the content is sufficiently detached from the original post, and whether any privacy or traceable information remains. Failed samples are re-accepted after targeted revision, and are removed from the released set if they still do not meet the requirements.
blocks.zh: 重写样本经过独立验收,重点是证据依赖类型是否保留,图像和文字是否一致,内容是否与原始帖子足够脱节,是否还存在任何隐私或可追踪信息. 失败的样本在目标修正后重新接受,如果仍未达到要求,则从释放的样本中移除。

blocks.en: E.5 Released-Set Composition and Privacy Checks
blocks.zh: E.5 释放的一组组成和隐私检查

blocks.en:
The sealing stage performs a rewrite-quality check on all 498 498 samples. On the text side, the mean character 3-gram repetition rate is 0.034 0.034 and the mean SequenceMatcher similarity is 0.216 0.216 ; on the image side, the mean pHash Hamming distance is 30.5 30.5 with a minimum of 12 12 , and the mean SSIM
is 0.192 0.192 . Table 8 summarizes these metrics, showing that the released version has significantly reduced its textual and visual surface similarity to the source posts. The released set consists of 166 166 each of Symbol, Visual and Hybrid, covers 20 20 verticals, and contains 518 518 images in total.

blocks.en: 附录 F Human Annotation and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 附录F 人的注释和质量控制

blocks.en: F.1 Annotators and Task Flow
blocks.zh: F.1 注释员和任务流程

blocks.en:
All data annotation was carried out by three graduate students with an artificial-intelligence background; candidate filtering, type determination, privacy-preserving rewriting and sealing re-review lasted two weeks in total. The annotation interface shows the Chinese image description, the title and body, the corresponding image and the candidate label simultaneously, and annotators
could cross-check against the original note. Each candidate is kept or removed by a human, and grouped into Symbol, Visual or Hybrid by the evidence the translation requires; model pre-labeling is used only as an aid for filtering. The basis for Visual and Hybrid judgments includes: person or object reference requiring the image to resolve, quantity, attribute or semantic ambiguity resolved by the image, or in-image text carrying key meaning. Symbol requires that internet-culture knowledge is necessary to complete the translation while the image provides no key semantics.
blocks.zh:
所有数据注释均由三名具有人工智能背景的研究生进行;候选人过滤,类型确定,隐私保留重写和封存重审共持续两周. 注释界面同时显示中文图像描述,标题和正文,对应图像和候选标签,以及注释符.
可对照原注核对。 每个候选人都由人类保存或移除,并按翻译所需的证据分为符号、视觉或混合体;模型预贴标签仅用作过滤的辅助工具。 视觉和混合判断的基础包括:要求图像解决的人物或对象参考,数量,属性或语义模糊性由图像解决,或带有关键意义的内图像文本. 符号要求互联网文化知识是完成翻译的必要条件,而图像则不提供关键语义.

blocks.en: F.2 Sealing-Stage Quality Control
blocks.zh: F.2 密封-结构质量控制

blocks.en: Sealing re-inspection includes two checks: “is the image description accurate” and “is the privacy-preserving rewrite qualified.” The image description must cover the subject, scene, attributes or in-image text needed to complete the translation, and must not add information not present in the image; the rewrite check verifies the evidence-dependency type, image-text consistency, naturalness of social-media expression and privacy risk. Failed samples are removed or manually revised and re-accepted.
blocks.zh: 封存的重新检查包括两项检查:“图像描述是否准确”和“保留隐私的重写是否合格”。 图像描述必须涵盖完成翻译所需的主体,场景,属性或图像内文本,不得添加图像中不存在的信息;重写检查要验证证据-依赖性类型,图像-文本一致性,社交媒体表达的自然性和隐私风险. 失败的样本被移除或手动修改并重新接受.

blocks.en: F.3 Human Annotation for Judge Validity
blocks.zh: F.3 法官效力的人类注释

blocks.en: The judge-validity experiment uses an independent scoring task. We stratified-sample 60 60 notes from the benchmark ( 20 20 each of Symbol, Visual, Hybrid), and the 10 10 model configurations listed in 3.3 each generate one translation under text-only and multimodal conditions, giving 60 × 10 × 2 = 1,200 60\times 10\times 2=1{,}200 translations to score. Annotators view the human-verified image description, the Chinese source and the English translation, and give an overall score by the 0 0 – 3 3 cultural-effectiveness standard defined in this paper; these model configurations match the translator main experiment, but here they only serve to produce translations covering diverse quality and error modes for validating the judge, not to compare translators. After removing invalid pairs with missing translations or incomplete human annotation ( 40 40 pairs, involving 2 2 notes), we keep 1,160 1{,}160 valid human–Judger pairs covering 58 58 notes (Symbol 18 18 , Visual 20 20 , Hybrid 20 20 ). Scores are further folded into a binary split of effective ( 2 2 – 3 3 ) and ineffective ( 0 0 – 1 1 ) to compute accuracy, Cohen’s κ \kappa and class-level metrics. The full results are in 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 裁判力实验采用独立的评分任务. 我们从基准(符号,视觉,混合体各20个)中分层分解出60个音符,3.3中列出的10个模式配置在文本和多模式条件下产生1个音符,给出60×10×2 = 1200 60\times 10\times 2=1{,}200个音符翻译得分. 注释者查看经人验证的图像描述,中文来源和英文翻译,按照本文定义的0–3 3文化效果标准给出总体分数;这些模型配置与翻译主实验相匹配,但在这里它们只用于制作涵盖不同质量和错误模式的翻译,用于验证法官,而不是比较翻译. 在删除了缺少翻译或不完整的人类注释的无效配对(40,40对,涉及2,2个音符)后,我们保留了1,160,1{,}160个有效的人–法官配对,覆盖58,58个音符(符号18,视觉20,Hybrid 20). 分数进一步折叠成二进制分数有效(2 2 – 3 3)和无效(0 0 – 1 )来计算准确性, Cohen 的 ob \ kappa 和 类级 度量衡. 全部结果为3.3。

blocks.en: This appendix supplements the translator decoding and judge inference settings. Each model uses the same prompt and decoding configuration under the four translator conditions, changing only the accessible evidence; real images are all input through the model’s native image part, without any external OCR or automatic image-captioning module.
blocks.zh: 本附录补充翻译解码和判断推论设置. 每个模型在四个翻译条件下使用相同的即时和解码配置,只改变可获取的证据;真实的图像都是通过模型的原生图像部分输入的,没有任何外部的OCR或自动图像封装模块.

blocks.en: G.1 Translator Decoding and Runtime Settings
blocks.zh: G.1 翻译解码和运行时设置

blocks.en: Except where limited by the interface, the translator sampling temperature is set to 0.7 0.7 ; GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 and Kimi-K3 use the interface default temperature. The maximum generation length is 8192 8192 tokens, relaxed to 32768 32768 for long samples of GLM-5.3-Flash. Self-hosted models use 8 8 -way tensor parallelism ( tp = 8 \mathrm{tp}=8 ) with a 32768 32768 maximum context and thinking mode disabled. The four conditions Text Only, Multimodal, Random Image and Human Caption keep the same prompt and decoding settings, changing only the input evidence.
blocks.zh: 除受接口限制外,翻译采样温度设定为0.7 0.7;GPT-5.5,GPT-5.6和Kimi-K3使用接口默认温度. 最大生成长度为8192 8192令牌,对GLM-5.3-Flash的长样本放宽至32768 32768. 自装机型采用8 8 - 径抗拉强度平行论(tp = 8\mathrm{tp}=8),最大上下文和思维模式32768 32768 已禁用. 四个条件只有文本,多模式,随机图像和人类标题保持相同的即时和解码设置,只更改输入证据.

blocks.en: G.2 Judge Inference Settings
blocks.zh: G.2 法官推论设置

blocks.en:
The Judger uses deterministic decoding, with temperature set to 0.0 0.0 , top_p set to 1.0 1.0 , a maximum output length of 2048 2048 tokens, and thinking mode disabled. The judge reads the same Caption Only evidence—the human-verified Chinese image description—under all translator conditions; the specific input organization is given in 3.2 and Appendix D.3 . The comparison judges in Table 3 include the raw Qwen3.5-27B without domain training, Gemini-3.1-pro, Qwen3.5-397B and Qwen3-32B. They also use
temperature = 0.0 =0.0 and follow the same input evidence, scoring rubric and output format as the Judger, to keep the comparison conditions consistent.
blocks.zh:
